[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] '''Bornet Lorax''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Lorax was a supporter of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Zerex]], of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Adinorr]]. When Zerex was promoted to become the [[Moff/Legends|moff]] of the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]], Lorax attended a celebratory party that Zerex held in his mansion on Ord Adinorr.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
